title: Storyblok Webhook Payload
description: The payload delivered by Storyblok to registered webhook endpoint URLs when subscribed events occur in a space. Payloads are delivered as HTTP POST requests with Content-Type: application/json. An optional webhook-signature HMAC-SHA1 header is included when a webhook secret is configured.

action.description: The event action that triggered the webhook delivery. Identifies the type of event and the affected resource type.

space_id.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space in which the event occurred.

text.description: Human-readable description of the event including the resource name, ID, and action performed.

story_id.description: Numeric ID of the story that triggered the event. Present for story.published, story.unpublished, story.deleted, and story.moved events.

full_slug.description: Full URL slug of the affected story at the time of the event. Present for story.published and story.moved events.

asset_id.description: Numeric ID of the asset that triggered the event. Present for asset.created and asset.deleted events.

datasource_id.description: Numeric ID of the datasource whose entries were updated. Present for datasource.entries_updated events.

StoryPublishedPayload.description: Webhook payload for the story.published event, delivered when a story is published.

action.description: Always published for this event type.

story_id.description: ID of the story that was published.

space_id.description: ID of the space containing the published story.

full_slug.description: Full URL slug of the published story.

text.description: Human-readable description of the publication event.

StoryUnpublishedPayload.description: Webhook payload for the story.unpublished event, delivered when a story is removed from public access.

action.description: Always unpublished for this event type.

story_id.description: ID of the story that was unpublished.

space_id.description: ID of the space containing the story.

text.description: Human-readable description of the unpublish event.

StoryDeletedPayload.description: Webhook payload for the story.deleted event, delivered when a story is permanently removed from the space.

action.description: Always deleted for this event type.

story_id.description: ID of the story that was deleted.

space_id.description: ID of the space from which the story was deleted.

text.description: Human-readable description of the deletion event.

StoryMovedPayload.description: Webhook payload for the story.moved event, delivered when a story is moved to a different folder.

action.description: Always moved for this event type.

story_id.description: ID of the story that was moved.

space_id.description: ID of the space containing the story.

text.description: Human-readable description of the move event.

AssetEventPayload.description: Webhook payload for asset events including asset.created and asset.deleted.

action.description: The asset action: created when a new asset is uploaded, deleted when an asset is removed.

asset_id.description: ID of the asset that was created or deleted.

space_id.description: ID of the space containing the asset.

text.description: Human-readable description of the asset event.

DatasourceEventPayload.description: Webhook payload for datasource.entries_updated events, delivered when datasource entries change.

datasource_id.description: ID of the datasource whose entries were updated.

space_id.description: ID of the space containing the datasource.

text.description: Human-readable description of the datasource update event.
